# Lorenzo White

## Overview

- **Gender:** male  <sub>[v2 VI All Sorts and Conditions of Men . . . and women P49](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0049), [v2 VI All Sorts and Conditions of Men . . . and women P55](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0055)</sub>
- **Origin:** Brierley  <sub>[v2 VI All Sorts and Conditions of Men . . . and women P46](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0046)</sub>
- **Status:** alive  _(assumed)_

## Appearance

_Not yet known._

## Personality

Lorenzo White is known to be extremely stingy, with his penny-pinching nature often compared to that of [Levi Gammon](../character/levi-gammon.md). Despite his usual reluctance to part with money, he is willing to contribute to a cause at a moment's notice.

_Sources: [v2 VI All Sorts and Conditions of Men . . . and women P49](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0049), [v2 XIV A Danger Averted P57](../source/v02-c14.md#nw-v02-c14-p0057)_

## History

During a day of soliciting donations throughout [Brierley](../codex/places.md#brierley), [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) approached Lorenzo White to request a contribution. She took advantage of Lorenzo's excitement regarding his new baby boy to successfully secure a large donation from him.

_Sources: [v2 VI All Sorts and Conditions of Men . . . and women P34](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0034), [v2 VI All Sorts and Conditions of Men . . . and women P44](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0044), [v2 VI All Sorts and Conditions of Men . . . and women P49](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0049), [v2 VI All Sorts and Conditions of Men . . . and women P56](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0056)_
